original_problem_statement: I want to build a mobile app that lets a farmer take a photo of a diseased coffee leaf and tells them which disease it is and what to do about it.
clarified_problem_statement: Build an Android-only offline mobile app that lets a coffee farmer photograph a leaf, then instantly shows the diagnosed disease name and a short, plain-language, step-by-step treatment guide (no chemical names or dosages, only practical actions such as pruning, spacing, shade management). The guide text will be supplied later in English and Kannada.
expected_input: A photo of a coffee leaf captured with the phone camera.
expected_output: The disease label plus a placeholder for a short treatment guide in English and Kannada (practical agronomic steps only, no chemical names or dosage).
constraints:
- Platform: Android only, offline-first (no image leaves the device).
- Accuracy: >= 90% correct diagnosis.
- Latency: <= 3 seconds per inference on typical Android hardware.
- Model size: <= 50 MB.
- Languages: English and Kannada (for the guide text you will add later).
- Treatment guide: only practical steps (pruning, spacing, shade management); no chemical names or dosage.
- Privacy: all processing on-device.
datasets_and_technologies: Research should identify publicly available coffee leaf disease image datasets, noting which coffee varieties (Arabica, Robusta) each covers. Also identify open‑source models and research papers that can run offline on Android (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, PyTorch Mobile) and meet the size and latency constraints.
other_requirements: The actual treatment guide text (English/Kannada) will be written later by the user; the app only needs to provide a placeholder for it. No chemical names or dosages should appear in the guide.
assumptions:
- The exact list of coffee leaf diseases to detect is not yet defined; it will be derived from the datasets found.
- The user will supply the final treatment guide content after model selection/training.
- Integration of the guide text into the app is out of scope for this research.
- Available Android hardware is typical consumer devices capable of running TensorFlow Lite/ONNX models within the specified constraints.
research_focus: Identify suitable publicly available coffee leaf disease datasets (including variety coverage) and open‑source models/papers that can be deployed offline on Android, satisfying the accuracy, latency, and size constraints.
